description: An arched horizon printed in halftone, where the dots grow with the light until they fuse into a smooth glow. WebGL background, free from uibrik (uibrik.com).

name: Ascii Field
description: A slow field of light drawn as type, glyphs thickening where it brightens; the pointer brings a lens that reshuffles them. WebGL background, free from uibrik (uibrik.com).

name: Halftone
description: A screen of lit dots: swirling ribbons of light drawn by the size and brightness of each dot. WebGL background, free from uibrik (uibrik.com).

name: Fold Toolbar
description: An icon button that unfolds into a tray of tools, pushing its neighbours aside, and folds back into the tool you pick. Free component from uibrik (uibrik.com).

name: Wave Type
description: Rows of repeated type that slide, track and stretch into living waves, hourglasses and diamonds, cutting between flat two colour palettes like a motion poster.

name: Brick Digits
description: A big numeral built from stacked black bricks that slide, split and merge row by row to morph between digits.

name: Lens Clock
description: A live analog clock seen through a breathing fisheye lens, with huge cream numerals that swell off the rim and magnify toward your pointer.

name: Dot Tiles
description: Black glass metric tiles with dot-matrix numerals that count up dot by dot, draw in their sliders, sleep steps and timelines, then drift gently live.

name: bw liquid
